maddeler.e:
نرتاد (form VIII)
# نَرْتَادُ (nartādu) /nar.taː.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَادَ (irtāda)
# نُرْتَادُ (nurtādu) /nur.taː.du/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَادَ (irtāda)
# نَرْتَادَ (nartāda) /nar.taː.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَادَ (irtāda)
# نُرْتَادَ (nurtāda) /nur.taː.da/: first-person plural non-past
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
